Package edu.scu.phantommaze.model

Class Weapons

java.lang.Object
edu.scu.phantommaze.model.Weapons
public class Weapons extends Object
The player's guns: which one is held, how much ammo is left, and the timers that stop the player from shooting too fast or while reloading.

      public boolean tryFire()
      Tries to fire the held gun. Fails if the gun is still cooling down, reloading, or empty.

      public void equipBfg(double readyIn)
      Switches to the BFG for rampage mode. It cannot fire until the flame transition is over.
      Parameters:
      readyIn - seconds until the first shot is allowed

    • equipPistol

      public void equipPistol()
      Puts the shotgun or BFG away (any shells left are lost) and goes back to the pistol.

    • getAmmo

      public int getAmmo()
      Ammo for the held gun: bullets in the pistol clip, or shotgun shells. The BFG has unlimited ammo, so the status bar leaves the number blank for it (like Doom's fist and chainsaw).
      Returns:
      the ammo count shown on the status bar (0 for the BFG)

    • isReloading

      Tells whether the pistol is being reloaded.
      Returns:
      true while reloading

    • getReloadProgress

      public double getReloadProgress()
      How far along the reload is.
      Returns:
      0 (just started) to 1 (done); 0 when not reloading
